adh_rate._comment: 2026-09-18 v6: added clinically reviewed bounds 0-0.15 (unmerged review tag archive/concept-clinical-bounds-ee33539). fluid_balance.description: hourly fluid balance (total_input_ml - urine - other_output_ml); emitted only for stays with recorded intake, so a stay without intake capture never becomes -urine. Non-urine output covers drains, gastric/enteral tube output, stool, ostomy, emesis, wound drainage and taps; RRT fluid removal is not subtracted (stratify or adjust for RRT). HiRID: hourly input minus total output from its daily counters.

hirid._comment: 2026-11-03: HiRID records daily (12:00-reset) cumulative counters for fluid INPUT (30005010) and fluid OUTPUT (30005110). 30005110 is >= 0.9x time-weighted urine on 91% of well-covered days (median 1.46x; urine 10020000 is a sparse rate), so HiRID balance is input minus total recorded output, emitted only for patients with both counters. This differs from the input - urine definition elsewhere.

infection_icd._comment: 2026-07-17 provenance correction: this was described as 'based on Angus 2001 criteria'. Angus et al. 2001 is an ICD-9-CM code list; this implementation is a 30-keyword regex over eicu.diagnosis.diagnosisstring (392,374 / 2,710,672 rows match) and must not be cited as Angus. Known false positives: 'ulcerative colitis'/IBD (~709 rows), non-infectious pericarditis/cystitis variants. eICU's native 'infectious diseases|' top-level diagnosisstring category would be a cleaner anchor if this concept is ever promoted beyond exploratory use. | R5-EICU-014: require positive structured diagnosis phrases; row-local negation and noninfectious/ischemic/IBD qualifiers are excluded. Independent positive rows remain eligible.

total_input_ml.description: total fluid input volume in each ICU-anchored hour (mL) — MIIV/MIMIC-III MetaVision interval amounts and AUMC IV drugitems fluid totals are overlap-allocated with exact volume conservation; MIMIC-III CareVue amounts are booked at charttime; HiRID uses increments of the daily input counter 30005010; eICU uses every intakeoutput Intake (ml) entry and SIC uses native DataID 2200 FluidPerHour. Scope differs by database (MIIV/MIMIC-III/eICU include enteral/PO feeds; AUMC is IV only; pre-admission, cath-lab, OR, PACU and ED intake is excluded for MIIV, MIMIC-III MetaVision and CareVue), so per-database intake capture requires stratified sensitivity analysis.

hirid._comment: 2026-11-03: HiRID observations 30005010 is the cumulative fluid INPUT of the day, reset at 12:00 (full-data audit: never negative; 98.3% of decreases at exactly 12:00; >= saline 30005075 + colloid 30005080 counters on 99.99% of days). egfr._comment: 2026-07-17 arity fix: `concepts` has 3 entries but `aggregate` had 1, so age/sex fell back to 'auto'. Made explicit WITHOUT changing values: age/sex are id-level constants (the callback broadcasts them onto each crea row), so median(age)=age and first(sex)=sex. OPEN QUESTION, deliberately NOT changed: crea='min' yields the LOWEST creatinine = the HIGHEST (most optimistic) eGFR in the window. Worst-case semantics - used by the other derived indices - would be crea='max'. 'min' is defensible if the intent is a nadir/baseline creatinine. Decide explicitly before eGFR is used as an outcome-adjacent variable.

loop_diuretic_furosemide_eq._comment: 2026-11-03 extraction audit 2: new dose concept (audit #19), owner concept/diuretics.py. Only sources that record the administered amount of every dose: eICU (orders without administered amounts) has none; MIMIC-III CareVue counts furosemide doses charted with an amount (2026-11-04 round 3 F-23; infusion rows charted as a rate only and bumetanide charted in ml are not counted); MIMIC-IV/III MetaVision count IV doses only (enteral doses are not in inputevents); ethacrynic acid and fixed combinations are exposure-only. max 2000 mg per administration record is a plausibility bound applied per record before the hourly sum (more than ten times Brater's 160-200 mg IV ceiling dose and two days of a 40 mg/h maximal infusion); HiRID holds <10 such records, one oral torasemide entry of 102424 mg. | RI-04: MetaVision 228340 and AUMC 7244 interval amounts use positive half-open ICU-hour overlap; boluses remain point events. Equivalence factors: IV furosemide 1, enteral furosemide 0.5, bumetanide 40, torasemide 2 mg per mg; Brater, N Engl J Med 1998;339:387-395. | R5-EICU-021: eICU now uses charted mass-rate infusions with IV route evidence; orders without charting still contribute no dose.
